digest.component_or_area: Rebar LLM Agent structured run and failure handling
propositions: Pydantic Agent runs must report aggregate whole-run usage (sum of all attempts) in memory, telemetry, and exactly one durable JSONL row, never per-attempt rows.

Validation exhaustion must re-raise the identical original StructuredOutputError object found by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain; output-size/truncation exhaustion must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError when no Rebar object exists on the chain.
Failure diagnostics must preserve consumed requests, tool calls, and provider tokens without creating fictional usage values for calls that reported none.
Terminal failure artifacts must contain the complete final provider response only when artifact capture is enabled, and retry-wire omission must not mutate stored messages.
Unrelated UnexpectedModelBehavior exceptions without 'Exceeded maximum output retries' marker must remain unchanged.
